title: Technical Lead, AI R&D
description: Hands-on lead of a 5-engineer AI team: set the R&D roadmap and wrote the technical work packages for 6 national and Horizon Europe proposals, 3 funded (€1.2M, incl. TÜBİTAK 1832); 2 of my mentees were promoted to senior.
highlights: Architected MdsAI, the AI layer of the FlexCity support desk (60+ municipalities), built on 132K event-log rows / 29K tickets. After rollout, median time to first reply fell from 15.9 h to 2.4 h (Jan–Jun 2026, 9,800 tickets): 68% of new tickets get a cited draft from LoRA/QLoRA fine-tuned Gemma / Qwen 3 models served with vLLM, 61% of drafts go out with light or no edits (an estimated 1.5 FTE saved), and re-routed tickets fell from 24% to 9%. Product-scoped retrieval reached 97.4% Recall@5 offline vs 81.5% for dense MiniLM.

Co-lead Teus, a ₺4.5M TÜBİTAK 1832 river-discharge project: in backtests, attention-based seq2seq models forecast flood peaks 24 h ahead at 11% thresholded MAPE across 8 stations vs 38% for seasonal-naive.
Led the technical work on Horizon Europe consortium proposals for flood and fire prediction, translating domain requirements into research plans and system designs.

title: AI/ML Engineer → Senior AI/ML Engineer
description: Built and deployed forecasting, computer vision, and predictive-maintenance systems for municipal utility networks and industrial clients.
highlights: Built server-side screening of field-inventory photos for Enerjisa, previously annotated by hand: YOLOv8 detection, small classifiers and optimized OpenCV checks screened 1.2M photos at 1,000+ images/min on one RTX A5000, flagging 27% as unusable (blurry, duplicate, sky, hands, empty) and cutting manual annotation work by ~60%.
Designed IoT-driven waste-collection routing that turns live bin-fullness and fire/flood sensor events into priority routes.

Built predictive-maintenance classifiers on Enerjisa telemetry that flagged 78% of failures at least 5 days ahead at 2 false alarms per asset per month on a held-out year, plus models for CNC assembly lines; first-author paper on telemetry-based fault prediction (IEEE ISAS 2025).

Built LSTM forecasting pipelines for municipal water demand (İSKİ, Istanbul: 4.1% MAPE at a 7-day horizon vs 6.3% for the utility's previous method) and industrial gas and electricity consumption. Built TF-IDF and embedding-based routing of citizen complaints: 3,000 complaints a month reach the right department with 85% accuracy, and manual triage went from 2 days to same day.

title: AI/ML Engineer (Part-time Contract)
description: Built production recommender systems for commercial consumer platforms, combining multimodal and collaborative-filtering approaches.
highlights: Built a multimodal recommender for the online art gallery 'Collectors', matching artwork to users through textual profiles and CNN-extracted visual preferences.
Developed a collaborative-filtering engine for the audiobook app 'Dinlebi' using matrix factorization over user interaction history, with an onboarding flow designed to mitigate cold start.
Recommendation click-through rose 14% over the previous popularity list; both the Collectors and Dinlebi (120K users) systems stayed in production for 3+ years.
